explanation: The bridge takes its name from the Golden Gate strait it spans. Its colour, called International Orange, was chosen partly because it stands out in fog.

claims.text: The Golden Gate Bridge is painted an orange-red colour known as International Orange.
The Golden Gate Bridge is not painted gold, silver-grey or pale blue.
The Golden Gate Bridge is named after the Golden Gate strait, which it spans.
International Orange was chosen for the Golden Gate Bridge partly because it is visible in fog.
